messages:
Mira: quick sync - bringing up raven-liteq int4 on canary. primary check: funcall JSON parse success in streaming mode vs non-stream.
Arjun: what's the test matrix?
Mira: int4/int8, temps 0/0.3, stream vs non-stream, batch 1/4, 1k prompts + 200 long-arg stress prompts.
Javi: running schema-coverage-checker v0.3; collecting parse_failure_class, chunk-boundary fingerprints, trailing-comma hits.
bench-bot: job 1812345678-A started on canary-pool
Mira: baseline: int8 non-stream parse_success ~98.0%, int4 non-stream ~88.9%; int4 stream ~78.5%.
Tess: that stream gap is concerning. examples?
Mira: mid-string splits in stream chunks leaving unbalanced quotes. sample: { "tool_call": { "name": "log", "args": "{\"msg\": \"partial chunk here...\"}" } }
Arjun: two mitigation directions: server coalesce (hold flush if last token looks like mid-string) or client framing (prepend length header).
Javi: prototyped coalesce 32-byte lookahead: int4 stream parse_success -> 91.8%, p95 latency +120ms.
Mira: tried suffix-repair at finalization: +1.5% success but risks semantic changes if we auto-close things.
Lin: ops note: conservative coalesce increased per-worker memory during warmup; bumped buffer and stabilized. no persistent 5xx spikes.
Tess: product: recommend coalesce be opt-in for dedicated/enterprise and Console expose "parse-safety" knob. ship framing in SDK as long-term fix.
Mira: action items: 1) feature-flag coalesce opt-in; 2) schedule int4 kernel-pad calibration to reduce token jitter; 3) expand long-arg stress set; 4) nightly canary sweep for p50/p95 + parse_success.
bench-bot: job 1812345820 finished; artifacts -> s3://redwood-canary/1812345678/artifacts (coverage report + fingerprints).
